title: Practice / patient-access supervisor
prior_scope: Specific reporting lines are organization-specific and are not inferred from a generic title.

title: Provider authorization / precertification specialist
prior_scope: Works for requester; not payer intake. Local payer requirements and request stage determine the needed packet.

title: Provider denial / appeal specialist
prior_scope: Separate pre-service authorization disputes from post-service claim denials; actual notice determines route and deadlines.

title: Payer UM intake coordinator
prior_scope: Different employer/function from provider authorization specialist; decisions follow the actual plan/delegation. R13 describes some limited nonclinical approvals and assigned benefit-only decisions; it is not a national permission or medical-necessity-denial grant.

title: Delegated medical-group / review-vendor reviewer
prior_scope: Functional wrapper, not an extra profession; identify both employer and actual licensed/intake role. In R13, AZPC explicitly retains no delegation to process, decide or notify appeals; the plan handles that review.

title: Member-services representative
prior_scope: Explanation may be limited; the determination and notice remain the source for procedural rights.

title: Provider-services representative
prior_scope: May be combined with other service functions; do not infer final decision power from access to the case.

title: UM manager / operational supervisor
prior_scope: UCSD documents supervision of nurse case managers/referral coordinators in its own example; no universal payer organization chart is asserted.

title: Lead care manager / case manager
prior_scope: Credential may be nursing, social work or another background; separate coordination authority from that credential. Published staffing examples differ; this is not evidence of national role prevalence.

title: Administrative care coordinator / scheduling support
prior_scope: Administrative coordinator and licensed case manager may be distinct posts; do not infer credentials from title.

title: Patient / insured member
prior_scope: Capacity, minors, emergencies and surrogate authority require applicable law and case facts; this is not a blanket consent rule.

title: Informal caregiver / family support person
prior_scope: Information sharing depends on permitted involvement; access is not automatically access to the entire record.

title: Legally recognized personal representative
prior_scope: No universal national ordering of spouses, adult children or guardians is asserted; resolve governing state law and actual appointment.

title: Ordering / treating physician
prior_scope: License, privileges and clinical setting control the activity; this is not a hierarchy over insurer employees.

title: Referring / primary-care clinician
prior_scope: May be a physician, NP or PA under the relevant professional rules; this is a functional role, not an additional credential.

title: Treating / performing specialist
prior_scope: Clinical responsibility must be assigned for the actual service; specialist is not necessarily the organizational supervisor of the PCP.

title: Nurse practitioner
prior_scope: Specify state, population focus, privileges and any required practice arrangement before concluding independent authority. California examples separate practice category, furnishing authority and employer requirements. Prospective 104-availability wording is not proof of present individual certification or application availability.

title: Physician assistant / associate (jurisdiction-specific title)
prior_scope: PA means physician assistant in this profile; prior authorization is written out to avoid acronym confusion.

title: Provider physician adviser / peer-discussion clinician
prior_scope: May be the treating physician rather than a separate employee; duties depend on relationship to the patient and organization.

title: Treating psychiatrist
prior_scope: Treating psychiatrist and coverage reviewer must be identified separately even where both are physicians.

title: Palliative-care clinical team member
prior_scope: A team function comprising different professions, each retaining its own scope; identify the actual clinician for an order.

title: External diagnostic / clinical evidence author or custodian
prior_scope: This is an evidence-supply function spanning distinct professions, not a claim that laboratory staff, radiologists and therapists have identical permissions.

title: Independent clinical / specialty consultant
prior_scope: Differentiate contracted expertise, internal consultation and statutory independent review.

title: Registered nurse providing direct care
prior_scope: A direct-care RN, payer UM nurse and nurse case manager are different functions even if one person can hold more than one role.

title: Licensed practical / vocational nurse
prior_scope: State law and setting determine supervision and permitted activities; staffing title alone is insufficient.

title: Medical assistant / clinical-support assistant
prior_scope: Specific clinical tasks depend on state rules and training; this role is not interchangeable with a physician assistant.

title: Home-health aide / personal-care worker
prior_scope: Health-related tasks depend on state, training and supervision; personal support is not equivalent to skilled nursing.

title: Registration / patient-access representative
prior_scope: Identity, benefits verification and authorization are distinct checks even if performed by the same employee.

title: Provider insurance-verification / benefits specialist
prior_scope: Uses plan-specific information; a coverage estimate is not final claim adjudication.

title: Payer eligibility / benefit specialist
prior_scope: Exact benefit authority and decision notice are plan-specific; not every benefits specialist is authorized to issue a denial. R13 permits some assigned benefit-only decisions; actual signatory authority still requires the plan/delegation.

title: HIM / release-of-information specialist
prior_scope: Purpose matters: HIPAA minimum-necessary exceptions include specified treatment disclosures; other privacy requirements can still apply.

title: Clinical-documentation-integrity specialist
prior_scope: Documentation improvement is not permission to rewrite clinical facts to match coverage criteria.

title: Policy analyst / clinical regulatory adviser
prior_scope: Clinical adviser and nonclinical analyst may be separate professions; any clinical decision requires the actual credential and assignment.

title: Medical coding specialist
prior_scope: Authorization and claims can involve different code requirements; this role is conditional, not mandatory on every case.

title: Healthcare interpreter / communication-access professional
prior_scope: Qualification and access arrangements must fit the communication need; interpreting is distinct from written translation.

title: Healthcare translator
prior_scope: Language/format needs and quality review are organization-specific; the document author retains substantive responsibility.

title: Health educator / self-management coach
prior_scope: A licensed clinician may also provide education; distinguish the educational function from any separate clinical authority.

title: Referral coordinator
prior_scope: May share a job with scheduling or authorization; preserve those functions as separate milestones.

title: Appointed appeal representative
prior_scope: Verify standing, consent, route and deadlines from the actual notice; Medicare and commercial routes differ.

title: Patient-relations advocate
prior_scope: A complaint about service and an appeal of a coverage decision are separate routes; a job title does not establish appointment.

title: SHIP / consumer-assistance / ombudsman counselor
prior_scope: SHIP is Medicare-specific; ombudsman and consumer-assistance mandates differ and are not interchangeable.

title: Community health worker
prior_scope: Community trust does not substitute for clinical licensure; program training and role determine permitted services.

title: Patient navigator
prior_scope: May be a nurse, social worker, CHW or other trained worker; apply the actual credentials in addition to navigation role.

title: Health-care guide / nonclinical care guide
prior_scope: Partnership HealthPlan documents this title as an organizational example; do not impose it on every care program.

title: Discharge planner / transitions coordinator
prior_scope: Hospital 482.43 permits development by or under RN, social worker or other qualified personnel; do not impose RN-only staffing nationally.

title: Clinical / community pharmacist
prior_scope: Professional scope, collaborative arrangements and specific state permissions must be identified for therapy changes. Washington CDTA is one documented pathway for specified therapy activity; no universal requirement for a new physician instruction on each authorized action is inferred.

title: Pharmacy technician / medication-access coordinator
prior_scope: Technician permissions vary; medication-access work can be an advanced assignment but remains distinct from pharmacist judgment.

title: Medical social worker (credential-dependent practice)
prior_scope: Job titles and licensure differ; distinguish supportive casework from licensed clinical treatment. UCLA describes a pre-licensure Clinical Social Worker II assignment; clinical job wording does not establish independent clinical licensure.

title: Licensed clinical social worker
prior_scope: Exact clinical activities and independent practice depend on state license and setting, not a national generic job description.

title: Clinical psychologist
prior_scope: Prescribing and specialty testing permissions are jurisdiction- and qualification-specific. New Mexico documents additional conditional/full prescribing certification; ordinary psychology licensure alone does not establish it.

title: Licensed behavioral-health / substance-use counselor
prior_scope: Mental-health, addiction, marriage/family and peer credentials have different requirements; establish the specific credential before assigning clinical authority.

title: Safeguarding / protection-service professional
prior_scope: State reporting law and actual agency mandate are unresolved case variables; this card does not invent national reporting thresholds. The cited 2024 APS fact sheet has a 2028 full-compliance date; it does not prove uniform present implementation in every state or child-protection setting.

title: Registered dietitian / qualified nutrition professional
prior_scope: Credential, state rules, referral/order and facility privileges determine specific clinical permissions.

title: Physical therapist
prior_scope: State/direct-access, order and payer requirements can differ; do not infer one universal physician-supervision hierarchy. No particular state direct-access rule was established in this audit; attempted V20 was unavailable and is not used as proof.

title: Occupational therapist
prior_scope: Order, setting and scope requirements must be identified for the actual service.

title: Speech-language pathologist
prior_scope: Language access and speech/swallowing impairment are different needs and may require different professionals.

title: Respiratory therapist
prior_scope: Specific protocols and privileges determine independent adjustments; state and setting must be checked.

title: Scheduler / procedure coordinator
module_name: Access, receiving services and fulfillment network
prior_scope: Scheduling may occur before authorization, but completion/readiness must not be inferred from booking alone.

title: Financial counselor / assistance specialist
module_name: Access, receiving services and fulfillment network
prior_scope: Estimates, assistance approvals, authorization and final claims are separate records and decisions.

title: Home-health intake / coordination clinician
module_name: Access, receiving services and fulfillment network
prior_scope: Home-health rules apply to the specified setting; signatory and verbal-order acceptance requirements remain scoped.

title: Skilled-nursing / rehabilitation receiving-team coordinator
module_name: Access, receiving services and fulfillment network
prior_scope: This is a receiving coordination function; profession, orders and facility rules determine actual treatment authority.

title: Community resource / housing / food / benefit-support worker
module_name: Access, receiving services and fulfillment network
prior_scope: Broad service-partner family, not a single licensed occupation; record the actual agency and job before assigning permissions.

title: Transportation coordinator / dispatcher
module_name: Access, receiving services and fulfillment network
prior_scope: Functional synthesis from access-barrier and transport-support evidence; exact broker rules and payment route are not established here.

title: Transport driver / service-delivery worker
module_name: Access, receiving services and fulfillment network
prior_scope: Operational synthesis; vehicle, attendant and medical-transport qualification must be determined for the actual journey.

title: Equipment supplier / delivery or fitting staff
module_name: Access, receiving services and fulfillment network
prior_scope: The CMS power-mobility example has specific requirements; do not apply those mechanically to all equipment.

title: Infusion / other receiving-service coordinator
module_name: Access, receiving services and fulfillment network
prior_scope: Operational service-coordination model; exact service procedure and clinical signoffs require the actual provider protocol.

title: Billing / patient accounts / claim-denial worker
module_name: Access, receiving services and fulfillment network
prior_scope: Downstream claim adjudication and pre-service authorization are distinct; exact payment rules are outside a generic role title.

title: Payer nurse / licensed UM clinical reviewer
prior_scope: Under MA 422.566(d), anticipated adverse medical necessity requires appropriate licensed professional review; local policy may impose stricter physician escalation. R13 has both a wider professional-category list and medical-director final-responsibility language. Specific case review/signoff must be clarified, not inferred from either statement alone.

title: Payer physician reviewer / medical director acting on a case
prior_scope: Case-review function is distinct from organization-wide CMO governance; authority depends on product, license, expertise and delegation. R13 has both a wider professional-category list and medical-director final-responsibility language. Specific case review/signoff must be clarified, not inferred from either statement alone.

title: Payer behavioral-health reviewer
prior_scope: Psychiatrist, psychologist and counselor credentials are not interchangeable; apply actual product and review requirements. R13 has both a wider professional-category list and medical-director final-responsibility language. Specific case review/signoff must be clarified, not inferred from either statement alone.

title: Managed-care pharmacist / pharmacy reviewer
prior_scope: Medication pathways can differ from medical-service prior authorization and Part C item/service appeals. R13 has both a wider professional-category list and medical-director final-responsibility language. Specific case review/signoff must be clarified, not inferred from either statement alone.

title: Internal appeal / grievance coordinator
prior_scope: For MA, distinguish integrated plans and other applicable routes; grievance resolution is not necessarily coverage reversal.

title: Medical-necessity appeal / reconsideration physician
prior_scope: MA medical-necessity denial reconsideration requires an appropriately expert physician; do not extend this exact requirement to all products and dispute types.

title: Medicare Advantage independent-review entity reviewer
module_name: External review, regulator and court adapters
prior_scope: This is MA IRE review; do not label a commercial IRO or an Original Medicare contractor as the same route.

title: External-review administrator
module_name: External review, regulator and court adapters
prior_scope: Exact administrator and permissible actions must be identified from product and notice.

title: Applicable commercial independent-review organization reviewer
module_name: External review, regulator and court adapters
prior_scope: HealthCare.gov describes required insurer acceptance in the process it covers; determine state/federal/plan route before applying it.

title: Regulator / oversight official
module_name: External review, regulator and court adapters
prior_scope: Identify agency, program and legal route; no blanket authority is assigned to every regulator or ombudsman.

title: MA administrative law judge / applicable adjudicator
module_name: External review, regulator and court adapters
prior_scope: Standing, filing and any amount-in-controversy rules must be checked; no threshold amounts are invented here.

title: Medicare Appeals Council reviewer
module_name: External review, regulator and court adapters
prior_scope: The precise review scope and procedural requirements require the actual notice/rules; no automatic appeal entitlement is implied.

title: Federal district court in an eligible Medicare appeal
module_name: External review, regulator and court adapters
prior_scope: Exhaustion, standing, filing and threshold conditions matter; the map is not a procedural filing guide.

title: Determination / notification coordinator
prior_scope: Contents, recipients and deadlines depend on the actual product/process; no universal time limit is encoded here.

title: Quality-improvement / audit professional
prior_scope: Audit access and methods must be authorized; observational findings are not automatically causal evidence.

title: Health-services / population-health data analyst
prior_scope: Reporting access and measure interpretation require actual data governance; algorithm output is not automatically a clinical determination.

title: Business / workflow analyst
prior_scope: Systems analyst authority is change-process authority, not authority over patient treatment.

title: Provider medical director / chief medical officer
prior_scope: Actual reporting lines, medical-staff authority and privileges require local bylaws/organization chart; no universal CMO-boss graph is asserted.

title: Payer medical director / clinical-program leader
prior_scope: In MA the UM committee is led by the plan medical director; governance and case-review roles are not the same authority edge.

title: UM / medical-policy committee and specialty members
prior_scope: MA committee requirements are explicit in A05; do not assume identical statutory composition for all insurance products.

title: Care-management director / manager
prior_scope: Partnership documents several management levels; exact titles and reporting relationships elsewhere remain local.

title: Clinical / case-management supervisor
prior_scope: R32 distinguishes RN, LVN, nonclinical and social-work supervisors; those qualifications must not be collapsed into one scope.

title: Trainer / clinical educator
prior_scope: A clinical educator may hold a clinical license, but its separate practice permissions are not supplied by the training title.

title: Compliance / regulatory professional
prior_scope: Actual legal interpretation and enforcement authority depend on role; local compliance staff are not the regulator.

title: Legal adviser / specialist legal representative
prior_scope: A lawyer is not automatically needed in ordinary authorization work; professional and appointment rules are issue-specific.

title: Privacy officer / HIM privacy specialist
prior_scope: Treatment, payment, patient access, representative authority and specially protected data can invoke different rules.

title: EHR / clinical informatics / application-support professional
prior_scope: Clinical informaticists may hold additional licenses; distinguish technical permissions from those independent credentials.

title: Identity / portal-access administrator
prior_scope: Operational synthesis of access-control support; actual IAM owner and escalation line must be locally identified.

title: Hospice interdisciplinary group and attending functions (distinct roles)
prior_scope: V11, V16 and V17 are the official October 2025 codification, not a complete current-2026 update check. They distinguish IDG/designated RN coordination, physician certification and admission. A patient-designated attending may have a different allowed credential; that does not grant every attending terminal-illness certification authority.

title: Chaplain / spiritual-care professional
prior_scope: Participation is needs/preference-dependent; protect the distinction between support and clinical decision authority.
